function.name: gui_automator
function.description: Interacts with the macOS graphical user interface. Use 'screenshot' to capture the current screen state. Use 'click' to interact with UI elements at specific X/Y coordinates. Use 'type' to input text into the currently focused field.

x.description: The X coordinate on the screen (Required if action is 'click').

y.description: The Y coordinate on the screen (Required if action is 'click').

text.description: The text string to type (Required if action is 'type').

target_to_find.description: Interacts with the macOS graphical user interface. Use 'screenshot' to capture the screen. CRITICAL: If you are trying to find a specific UI element to click (like a search bar or icon), you MUST include the 'target_to_find' parameter DURING the screenshot action. Use 'click' to interact with UI elements at specific X/Y coordinates. Use 'type' to input text into the currently focused field.
